Chapter 574: Chapter 18: Fear of the Demigod (Subscription Requested)

Lin Yuan sat on his throne, deep in thought.

For a century, he had intentionally allowed the ‘Lust’ Church to operate freely, as it was backed by the ‘Lust’ Mother Goddess, a powerful Demigod.

Theoretically, even if Lin Yuan were to remove all the covert agents of the ‘Lust’ Church from Longshan City, it was unlikely to provoke the ‘Lust’ Mother Goddess into action.

But it is always good to be prepared for any possibility.

After all, the people of the ‘Lust’ Church hiding in Longshan City posed no threat to Lin Yuan, who had never feared anyone under the circumstances of ‘maturation’ over time.

“It’s time to deal with the ‘Lust’ Church.”

...

Lin Yuan had made up his mind.

Whether it was because of the grudges of his original self, Longshan Yuan, or the petty actions the ‘Lust’ Church had taken against the Longshan Family over the past century.

Lin Yuan had no reason to spare the ‘Lust’ Church.

Previously, Lin Yuan lacked sufficient power; when he recovered to Seventh Rank, he worried that clashing with a Demigod-like the ‘Lust’ Mother Goddess would attract the attention of the Rank Church.

But now.

At least on Earth, Lin Yuan was invincible; even the divine incarnations of the twenty-four Prime Gods had proved far insufficient before him.

…

Underneath Anpu City.

This place was a luxurious palace, where groups of beautiful women clad in light veils walked together.

A short, plump man followed behind the group, his immense perception absorbing every detail of the palace interior.

“This must be the Lust Church’s largest new stronghold,” murmured the short, plump man, naturally, it was Lin Yuan, or more precisely, his Taiyang Divine Spirit.

Martial Tao Primordial Spirit, capable of Myriad Transformations, Lin Yuan had casually taken another form to come here.

Dealing with the mere Lust Church, there was no need for his true body to appear.

“Over these hundred-plus years, the Lust Church seems to have thrived quite well,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly

The Demigod behind the Lust Church, though not a True God, had also acquired some ‘lust’ abilities, which could make one feel ecstatic.

With such powers, the Lust Church had smoothly ‘controlled’ some upper levels of Anpu City, as well as core family members in several nearby Viscounty territories.

The group Lin Yuan was following included some of Anpu City’s young second-generation, who were specifically here to indulge.

“The Demigod of the Lust Church, if she could gather faith, raise her divine throne, and achieve the position of a True God, then all the lust generated by the humans on Earth would become the source of her faith…” Lin Yuan thought silently.

For example, the War Overgod, one of the twelve main gods of the dark abyss, grows stronger as human wars become more intense on Earth.

Therefore, the War Overgod constantly tries to incite various wars on Earth, but the twelve main gods of the Ocean of Light are relatively peaceful; the Main God of Rank, in particular, must maintain order on Earth, which is directly opposed to the War Overgod.

The standard for dividing the gods of the Ocean of Light and the dark abyss is not based on good or evil, but on the type of authority and faith they hold.

The Demigod behind the Lust Church, advocating the indulgence of lust, leans towards the dark abyss.

But whether it’s the main gods of the Ocean of Light or the dark abyss, their foundation lies in all beings, in faith.

If all beings disappear and faith ceases, the fate of these main gods will also fall.

“Sirs, I will take you inside next to enjoy true bliss… so I will be asking for your identities and names…” said a seemingly frail and delicate woman, easy to awaken men’s protective desires.

The young second-generation men of Anpu City lined up in front of Lin Yuan nodded in agreement, some of them were impatient, clearly not their first visit.

Soon.

The fragile woman came to Lin Yuan.

“This sir…” the fragile woman examined Lin Yuan carefully, her expression changing slightly.

As a chief admin of Lust Church, she recognized most of the young masters from Anpu City, asking their identities was just a formality.

But now?

The frail woman realized she didn’t recognize the short, plump man before her.

Given the man’s distinctive stout appearance, the frail woman would have had a deep impression had she seen him even once; she wouldn’t be as unfamiliar as she was now.

“Who exactly are you, and what are you doing here ?” Although the frail woman’s skepticism rose within her, she maintained her composure, trying to stabilize the situation with Lin Yuan.

The rigorous screening to enter the underground palace wasn’t lax; simply following the large group wasn’t enough.

Lin Yuan suddenly appearing here meant something significant.

“Who I am is not your concern.”

Lin Yuan grinned, showing his white teeth, “As for why I’m here?”

“I’m here…”

Lin Yuan paused for a moment, then stated matter-of-factly, “to kill your god!”

As soon as he finished speaking.

The head of the frail woman before him exploded first, centered around Lin Yuan, the brains of all the beautiful women within a several hundred-mile radius of the luxurious underground palace burst.

The young second-generations of Anpu City who came to indulge, as well as the core family members from surrounding Viscount territories, suffered the same fate.

In less than a breath’s time, nearly everyone in the lavish underground palace was dead, including twelve Fourth Level Knights and four Fifth Level Knights.

“Now just the deepest part remains…” Lin Yuan didn’t stop; he continued toward the deepest part of the palace,

There was a unique divine power resisting the shadowy influence of Lin Yuan’s World.

In truth, with Lin Yuan’s current strength, even just a Primordial Spirit, he was not something a mere Seventh Rank Demigod could withstand,

But in this World, there were the extensive Magic Webs arranged by the Goddess of the Magic Web from Ocean of Light.
